pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   D. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   C. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Eid has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. C — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. B — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Relationship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Arabic; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
